ai.title: Add fetch-monthly-revenue script
ai.summary: New `scripts/fetch-monthly-revenue.ts` added to aggregate Stripe balance transactions. Script queries hardcoded months (Sept-Dec 2025), paginating `stripeServer.balanceTransactions.list` with `starting_after`. Calculates gross, fees, refunds, and net revenue, printing a formatted console summary. Detects test vs live mode via `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` prefix.

eli5.text: A new financial reporting tool has been added to the company's internal systems that automatically pulls revenue data from Stripe for the last four months of 2025 (September through December). This tool calculates total sales, processing fees, refunds, and net revenue for each month, then prints a clear summary table showing how much money came in, how much went to transaction fees, and how much was lost to customer refunds. Only internal staff with access to the company's systems will see this report when running the tool, and it works by reading transaction records directly from Stripe's dashboard-style data, automatically detecting whether it's looking at test data or real customer payments based on the secret key used.
